chunks: And by this chain, from Hafs, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever is a traveler should travel on the day of Saturday. Even if a stone were to fall from a mountain on the day of Saturday, Allah, Exalted is His mention, would return it to its place. And whoever finds their needs difficult to fulfill should seek to obtain them on the day of Tuesday, for it is the day in which Allah softened the iron for Dawud (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended day for traveling and fulfilling needs according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from Al-Kafi underscores the concept of *tawqīf* (divine timing) by linking specific weekdays to cosmic ease, suggesting that Saturday is optimal for travel due to the stability of creation, while Tuesday is favored for securing needs as it marks when Allah softened iron for Prophet Dawud. This reflects the broader theological view that time itself carries spiritual potency, encouraging believers to align their worldly affairs with these divinely ordained moments of grace.
